description: This file contains the definition of the Tree class, which manages hierarchical data structures (trees) for a web interface, including methods for adding nodes, generating headers, and initializing tree data for rendering with JavaScript.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: A class that represents a tree structure with capabilities to add nodes, generate HTML/JavaScript for presentation, and manage tree parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Tree object with a name and a JSON encoder instance.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a node object to the tree's node collection.

methods.name: generate_header
methods.description: Generates HTML tags to include CSS and JavaScript files necessary for the tree view.

methods.name: set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter key-value pair for customizing the tree's behavior.

methods.name: generate_nodes_array
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript snippet that initializes the tree with node data and parameters.

methods.name: generateNodesNoInit
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to define node data without immediately initializing the tree, allowing deferred initialization.

methods.name: generateNodesRaw
methods.description: Returns raw array data of the node structure and parameters, suitable for further processing.
